seat.BEST_WHY: The rope-bound timber bundle at roughly (380–500, 585–640) is the one prop in the whole deck that is actually drawn: two logs crossed, end-grain visible on the cut ends, the rope wraps around the crossing with individual turns and a knot, and the log tops take the light from the figure above while the undersides drop into the floor's blue shadow. It sells the "repaired with rope and salvage" fiction without a caption. The brazier at (598,548) is an iron bowl with a fire in it and a soft warm bloom around it, not an icon. The lintel run along the top wall (y≈420–450) is a row of separate timber slabs with dark driven pins at irregular spacing, so it reads as pinned planks rather than a repeated tile. The base lighting — warm falloff from the figure, cooler blue in the shadow — is the strongest thing in frames 1/3/4 and is doing real work here.
seat.WORST_WHY: The brazier at (600,550) is a dark disc ringed by ten white rounded petals around a red flame — at play size it reads as a daisy, not a fire. The three floor props — thin orange X at (215,615), red crossed-planks at (405,615), orange two-rail-and-rungs shape at (530,615) — are ~40px flat symmetric icons, all the same saturated orange, none with a contact shadow, and none receiving the scene's light: the X at (215,615) sits in the dark blue zone at the same brightness as the one in the light pool. The rung shape reads as a ladder or a biplane, not as anything an orc would have repaired. The small box at (345,545) is a tiny oblique-view chest with a lit front face in a straight-top-down world. Everything placed on this floor looks like placeholder markup dropped over a finished background.

_what: THE ITEM'S OWN MEASURED EXIT — required by INSTALL-LATEST (Rafe, 2026-09-08).
A build installs because it DID THE THING IT SET OUT TO DO. The rank test only says
the doing cost nothing against the seeded reference; this says what was done. Without
it, 'not worse than the reference' would mean 'not different from it', and a round
that changed nothing would install as readily as one that fixed something.
Declared here per item, recorded into the verdict, re-checked at the gate. The gate
refuses a `met` with no measurement behind it.
